2i43aAn2rq8.context: Released in early 1972, 'Everything I Own' by Bread represents the commercial and emotional high-water mark of the soft rock movement that dominated US AM radio in the early 1970s. Its restrained visual presentation in this clip reflects the pre-MTV era, where promotional visuals were secondary to radio airplay. 2i43aAn2rq8.sig: A defining artifact of early-1970s soft rock, this performance document captures Bread at peak commercial viability. The song's harpsichord texture, Gates's falsetto-to-chest vocal technique, and the band's studio-precision arrangement set a template for adult contemporary balladry that shaped the genre through the decade and beyond.
